claim_text: The 2021 international consensus recommends that NF1 be diagnosed in an individual without a parent with NF1 if two or more are present: >=6 cafe-au-lait macules, axillary/inguinal freckling, >=2 neurofibromas or 1 plexiform neurofibroma, optic pathway glioma, >=2 Lisch nodules or choroidal abnormalities, a distinctive osseous lesion, or a heterozygous pathogenic NF1 variant at ~50% allele fraction.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Modified Delphi expert consensus (74/76 experts); rubric forbids expert_opinion at strength >=4, so capped at 2. Recommendation, not an empirical finding.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
